title: LiveElementPressedPayload
description: live.element.pressed v1 (OpenVibe.Live server/elements): a viewer's element press was accepted and ran. It carries the public facts the stream should see: the channel, the element's id and name, the presser's public name and subject, the trigger that fired, the channel points it cost and the element-state revision it left behind. It never carries the presser's email, address, account balance or anything private; a refused press does not produce it. Envelope: subject { type: element, id: el_… }, actor the presser's subject, visibility public, priority low. Also written to the channel's AI timeline as a moment, so the stream's own timeline can cite 'chat made the robot dance'.

channel.description: The public channel facts (the channel page is public already).

presser_name.description: The display name the stream shows, never an email or an account id.

points_spent.description: Channel points the press cost; 0 when it was free.

state_revision.description: The element-state revision after the actions ran; 0 when the element has no state yet.
